title: SNI Security of Parallel Multiplication with One Refreshing
summary: The proposed parallel multiplication algorithm with one refreshing operation is conjectured to be SNI for every masking parameter d, but this remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether the proposed parallel multiplication algorithm composed with a single refreshing operation satisfies SNI security for every masking parameter $d$; equivalently, prove or refute the conjecture that this composition is SNI for any $d$.

scope.domain: Side-channel cryptanalysis of masking schemes and their SNI security.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove or refute that the proposed parallel multiplication algorithm composed with a single refreshing operation is SNI for every d.

citations.label: Parallel Implementations of Masking Schemes and the Bounded Moment Leakage Model

progress.summary: The source presents an explicit conjecture that its multiplication algorithm combined with a single refreshing is SNI for any d. The open task is to prove or refute it.
citation_labels: Gilles Barthe et al., Parallel Implementations of Masking Schemes and the Bounded Moment Leakage Model
